Dana is a member of #north-random, so she could see the correction herself. My earlier replies in Ilse's #north-team thread still say 261, so I told Dana those are out of date.

I also expired the 261 entry in the knowledge brain and saved 100 seats against Quarrendon Freight Lines, citing Ilse's correction. The brain still won't let me search it because the connection isn't tied to a member. So I can't check whether other pages there still say 261. Someone on the brain host can fix that with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.

No approvals were needed: a seat count isn't a finance figure.
